name: Bring It Down
rulesText: Deal 2 damage to chosen non-Scratch asset.

name: Mage Seeker's Inquisition
rulesText: Chosen opponent reveals their hand. You choose a unit card from it. That player discards that card.

name: Piston Fist
rulesText: Deal 1 damage to chosen unit, and chosen allied unit gets +1 power until end of turn.

name: Visionary's Insight
rulesText: Regroup up to one chosen exhausted allied asset.

name: Dolus Infusion
rulesText: Draw 2 cards, and your Headquarters heals 2.

name: Inspired Salvage
rulesText: Return up to 2 chosen Mechanized cards from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Railway Reinforcements
rulesText: Move up to 3 chosen allied units from your Reserves to the Main Theater.

name: Redline Infusion
rulesText: Chosen allied unit gets +2 power and gains Berserk until end of turn. At the end of your turn, kill that unit.

name: All-Out War
rulesText:
Discard your hand. Then:
- Chosen allied asset gets power equal to the number of cards discarded this way until end of turn.
- Scratch X, where X is the number of cards discarded this way.
- Regroup all Scratch Company units in your Reserves.

name: Armored Charge
rulesText: Regroup chosen allied Mechanized unit. It heals 5 and gains 2 armor.

name: Macrocannon Barrage
rulesText: Distribute 5 damage among up to 5 chosen units.

name: Fire for Effect
rulesText:
Opposing assets in the Main Theater gain Resistant -1 until end of turn.
Deal 1 damage to chosen asset in the Main Theater.

name: March of Progress
rulesText: Up to 2 chosen units gain the Mechanized subtype until end of turn. Allied Mechanized units gain 2 armor and get +2 power until end of turn.
